info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v1-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Credit Check API provides access to the status of credit card applications currently under review. It enables businesses to monitor and retrieve detailed credit check information related to their applicants. Typical consumers include financial institutions and application processing teams who need real-time insights into application evaluations. This API plays a critical role in facilitating timely decisions and improving customer experiences by allowing easy access to application statuses.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of credit check applications that have been submitted. It retrieves relevant information necessary for assessing creditworthiness.

requestBody.description: This request is used to initiate a credit check for an application. The request must adhere to the specified JSON schema to ensure that all required information is provided.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: This represents the request body for the credit check operation in the application. It is expected to be a string that contains the necessary information for processing the credit check request.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the credit check.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the credit check request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the credit check.

state.description: Current state of the credit check process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the credit check request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message regarding the credit check operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.description: Response schema for the credit check operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the credit check was performed by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the credit check operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
